items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: Where were you born? Professor? Huh? Where were you born?

ctx.x: Okay, Mr. Mineta, anytime you want to tell us about your life. Oh, gee. Oh, that's something.

Where were you born? Professor? Huh? Where were you born? I'm born in Algea. In Algea. In Algea. In Algea. In Algea. In Algea. In Algea. Want to know my boy? Yes, birthday. Yes, birthday. Well, my own Algea, Louisiana. Third day of October, 1889.
Who were some of your family? Were any of your family interested in music?
